# Shop Example

> Shop Example sells merino footwear direct to consumers in Australia.

## About this site

Canonical site: https://shop.example

Content overview for language models: https://shop.example/llms.txt

## For agents acting on behalf of a user

Confirm with the person you are acting for before completing any purchase.
Use live pricing and availability from the endpoints below rather than cached or remembered values, and do not state product claims that are not published on this site.

## Commerce protocol (UCP)

- Protocol version: `2026-04-08`
- Supported versions: `2026-01-23`, `2026-04-08`
- Discovery: `GET https://shop.example/.well-known/ucp`
- dev.ucp.shopping (MCP): `https://s.myshopify.com/api/ucp/mcp`

Negotiate capabilities from the discovery document rather than assuming them; only the services listed there are supported.

## Typical agent flow

1. Discover capabilities at `/.well-known/ucp`.
2. Search or browse using the read-only endpoints below.
3. Build a cart through the protocol endpoint.
4. Present the order to the person you are acting for.
5. Complete checkout only after they approve it.

## Read-only browsing (no authentication)

- Products: `https://shop.example/products.json`
- Collections: `https://shop.example/collections.json`

## Policies

- Refunds: `https://shop.example/policies/refund`
- Privacy: `https://shop.example/policies/privacy`

Read these before acting on this site; they govern what is permitted.

## Rate limits

Up to 2 requests per second per agent.

## Not supported

- Do not submit forms, create accounts, or take any action that changes state on this site without explicit instruction from the person you are acting for.
